title: TRESS: A Fixed-Size History Representation for Irregular Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.24257v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A fixed number of recent observations may span minutes for one variable and days for another. Earlier measurements can still reveal whether the latest value is unusual for that variable. We propose TRESS (Timestamped Recent Events and Statistical Summaries), a forecasting model that retains the latest observations at their original times and summarises the full history of each variable. For a given set of variables and event budget, this representation stays the same size as the record grows. Its query-conditioned event lifting module weights deviations from the latest value according to the age of each observation and the forecast horizon. A channel-specific decoder combines the resulting features with historical statistics and a summary shared across variables to predict a correction to the latest value. translated_title: TRESS：一种用于不规则时间序列预测的固定大小历史表示方法
translated_abstract: 固定数量的近期观测值对一个变量而言可能只跨越几分钟，而对另一个变量则可能跨越数天。较早的测量值仍能揭示最新值对该变量而言是否异常。我们提出了TRESS（带时间戳的近期事件与统计摘要），这是一种预测模型，它按原始时间保留最新的观测值，并对每个变量的完整历史进行摘要。对于给定的一组变量和事件预算，该表示的大小在记录不断增长时保持不变。其查询条件化的事件提升模块根据每个观测值的时间距离和预测时间范围，对相对于最新值的偏差进行加权。通道特定的解码器将所得特征与历史统计信息以及跨变量共享的摘要相结合，以预测对最新值的修正量。在为每个变量保留8到16个观测值的情况下，TRESS在所有四个基准数据集上比较的方法中取得了最低的平均测试MSE和MAE。
tldr: TRESS提出了一种固定大小的历史表示方法，通过保留带时间戳的近期观测值并摘要完整历史的统计信息，结合查询条件化的事件提升模块与通道特定解码器，在不规则时间序列预测上取得了最优的测试误差。
en_tdlr: TRESS introduces a fixed-size history representation that retains timestamped recent observations alongside statistical summaries of the full history, achieving the lowest test MSE and MAE on irregular time series forecasting benchmarks.
